description: Lufträume Deutsche Flugsicherung is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The areas of the airspace of Deutsche Flugsicherung over Germany with name, key, AIXM (Aeronautical Information Exchange Model) class and type, airspace class, minimum and maximum flight altitudes as well as operating times. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Airspaces German air traffic control" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2026-04-02 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
